name: @ijusttookadnatest/scarb-mcp

tools.name: install_scarb
tools.description: Install Scarb Cairo toolchain with optional version specification

version.description: OPTIONAL: Scarb version to install (e.g., "2.10.0", "2.12.1"). If not specified, installs latest version

tools.name: init_project
tools.description: Initialize a new Scarb project with specified name and options

projectName.description: Name of the project to initialize

path.description: Path where to initialize the project (defaults to current directory)

tools.name: build_project
tools.description: Build a Scarb project with specified build options

path.description: Path to the project directory (defaults to current directory)

tools.name: execute_program
tools.description: Execute a Cairo program with optional function and arguments

path.description: Path to the project directory (defaults to current directory)

executableType.description: OPTIONAL: The type of the executable to run: "TARGET" for a target name from Scarb.toml or "FUNCTION" for a function path like "package::module::function"

executableValue.description: OPTIONAL: The executable value: target name (e.g., "my_executable") or function path (e.g., "my_package::my_module::main")

executable.description: OPTIONAL: The executable information (target or function name)

mode.description: OPTIONAL: The execution mode. Default: bootloader

tools.name: prove_program
tools.description: Generate a proof for a Cairo program execution using Stone prover

path.description: Path to the project directory (defaults to current directory)

tools.name: verify_program
tools.description: Verify a proof generated for a Cairo program

path.description: Path to the project directory (defaults to current directory)

proofFile.description: Path to the proof file to verify

stderr: Starknet Scarb MCP Server running on stdio
